remarks: Beautifully remodeled in 2018, this 2-bedroom, 1-bath condo features hardwood floors in the living and dining areas, stone counters and stainless steel appliances in the kitchen, a walk-in closet in the master bedroom, and a bonus partially finished lower level with a washer and dryer. The unit includes a 1-car garage and an additional parking spot. Conveniently located just 3 minutes from the South Norwalk train station, 2 minutes from 314 Beer Garden, 5 minutes from AMC theaters and numerous restaurants, and 6 minutes from the SONO Collection mall and I-95/Route 7 ramps. Available from October 1st, possibly sooner.  Requirements: Good credit and monthly income of at least three times the rent.
